thread:
Priya: Heads-up — noticed a growing number of EU leads routed to US reps overnight. Looks like the HubSpot round-robin ignores lead.country / timezone and just uses queue position. Causing SLA misses for followups (SLA = 30m).
Sam: ugh. Do we have volume numbers? this explains the spike in missed SLA alerts this morning.
Priya: Sample: 1.2k leads last 72h; ~18% from EU routed to US pool between 00:00-06:00 UTC. Metric: inbound-handoff.sla_violation_count spiked by 42%.
Diego: Quick question — are we enriching IP -> geo upstream? If enrichment latency is high, round-robin will fallback incorrectly.
Priya: We enrich on ingest via HubSpot workflow calling our enrichment webhook. If enrichment takes > 90s we currently let the lead continue into assignment.
Kris: Proposal: (a) make rotation timezone-aware: prefer owners with local working hours; (b) implement a 2-tier fallback: local pool -> regional pool -> global pool; (c) if enrichment doesn't return in 10s, tag lead as "enrichment_pending" and put into short wait queue (max 120s) before falling back.
Emma: +1 on regional pools. Also request: dashboard per-region SLA + quick filter for "enrichment_pending" leads so SDR ops can triage queue.
Diego: HubSpot workflow suggestion (pseudo):
```
IF lead.country IN ("DE","FR","NL") AND hour_of_day(lead.created_at, lead.country_tz) BETWEEN 8 AND 18
  route_to: regional-roundrobin_eu
ELSE IF enrichment_status = "pending" AND wait_time < 120s
  hold_in_queue: enrichment-waitlist
ELSE
  route_to: global-roundrobin
```
Priya: For Salesforce customers we mirror assignment via the API. Kris — can we update SF assignment rules similarly? fallback key should be custom field: redwood_owner_pool -> "eu_pool"/"regional_pool"/"global_pool".
Kris: Yep. Will draft SF ruleset. Also adding a small integration: if a lead is in enrichment-waitlist > 120s, send a webhook to ops channel and increment metric inbound-handoff.enrichment_stall.
Sam: Does this require infra work? Diego, is the enrichment webhook sync or async?
Diego: It's currently sync (HTTP call). We can change to async with immediate ack and subsequent PATCH to HubSpot when enrichment completes. That will let us hold assignment without blocking HubSpot inbound. Minimal infra: a small queue + backoff for enrichment callbacks.
eng-bot: deploy request created: PR #4421 — "timezone-aware routing + enrichment waitlist" (staging). CI passed.
Priya: Next steps: 1) Kris + Diego draft HubSpot workflow & SF rules by EOD tomorrow, 2) Eng to review PR and validate staging routing, 3) Emma to add SLA tiles for regional view.
Sam: schedule 20m sync tomorrow after PR review. @eng @sales ops please join. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — will post follow-up with test plan and quick checklist (timezone mapping, enrichment latency buckets, fallback metrics).
Diego: quick workaround for today: add HubSpot filter to exclude leads with country null from US pool: property = country is known -> proceed, else route to global-temp. reduces bad routing by ~12%.
Emma: noted, I'll push that filter now and update ops playbook.
Priya: Closing the loop here — keeping the thread for audit.
